method.data: Lunanga, Stoop, Verpoorten & Desbureaux (2026), Energy Economics; Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/KPDREF (CC0)
method.protocol: Leave-one-site-out. Day-0 forecasts use no metered data from the held-out site.
method.day0_inputs: Potential customers (census) + AMDA 2024 consumption benchmarks (West & Central Africa) + ramp shapes fitted on the other metered sites.
method.percentiles: P90 = exceeded with 90% probability (conservative); P10 = optimistic.
method.metrics: WAPE = sum|P50 - actual| / sum actual over scored months; coverage = share of months with actual inside P90-P10 (target ~0.8); cum36 = error of P50 on cumulative energy over the next 36 months.

notes.Goma: Urban network (~16,700 potential customers in a city of ~2M). Outside the village mini-grid scope the tool targets; reported for transparency.
notes.Mutwanga: Consumption fell ~82% around month 22 after an armed-conflict shock documented by the source paper (M23). No demand model can foresee this; it is why bankability is stress-tested on the low (P90) case.
